title: Octoverse: Commits, pushes, reach new highs in 2026 as developers build with agents
summary:
See how a record year of growth reached every industry, every field, and every kind of builder in the 2026 Octoverse report.

The post Octoverse: Commits, pushes, reach new highs in 2026 as developers build with agents appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
llm_summary: The 2026 Octoverse report shows a record surge in GitHub activity—more commits, pushes, and overall reach than ever before—driven by developers across every industry and discipline. This growth is largely fueled by the rise of AI‑powered development agents that automate and augment coding workflows. In short, developers everywhere are building faster and at larger scale thanks to these new intelligent tools.
